about: Reshaped from research/lit/mffu_rules.json by tools/ledger_rules.py. The owner's real prices, one-time, $0 activation; the reset price is not published (null).

source.claude_md: Prop-firm prices: Builder 25K $63, the ATLAS 25K of 2026-10-26 $43, Builder 50K $91.80, one-time, $0 activation

payout.first: $500 net profit above the $2,100 buffer (balance >= $2,600), >= 2 traded days in the cycle, 50% best day, and 48 h after the first sim-funded trade
the 25K plan: 2 days to the first payout, then every 2 days (owner screenshots 2026-10-26)

caveats: The MFFU pages could not be opened when the rulebook was built: every rule is the search engine's reading of MFFU's own pages (checked 2026-10-18); re-check before a payout.
A reset price for one-time plans is not published: enter resets yourself.
Payout timing (how many days MFFU takes to pay) is not in the rulebook: the app shows how long a request has waited, never a promise.
